stayType: Small guest house in Barbrook, near Lynton
accommodation: Standard double and superior king rooms with garden views; about seven rooms
dogs: Dogs only, up to two, in specific rooms for a nightly fee; contact the guest house first
beachAccess: Not a beach location: Barbrook is a short drive from Lynton and Lynmouth, with the Valley of Rocks about 13 minutes away by car
confirmedFeatures: Complimentary cooked breakfast, garden, bar and lounge, free Wi-Fi in public areas, no lift, no front desk
overview: Exmoor Manor is a small guest house in Barbrook, inland of Lynton and Lynmouth on the edge of Exmoor National Park. It offers double and king rooms, a garden and a bar-lounge, and breakfast is included.
surfTripFit: An Exmoor walking base rather than a surf stay: it is a drive from Lynmouth and the nearest surf beaches are further west on the North Devon coast.
gaps: No official website found. The two booking sites agree on address, dogs, parking and breakfast; the children policy appears on one only. Confirm with the guest house.
verificationNote: Details cross-referenced from two online booking sites in October 2026; the property's own website could not be checked. Surfbooker has not stayed here; confirm facilities and policies directly when you enquire.
